text: Let us recap. Superposed light waves give I one plus I two plus two root I one I two cos phi. A path difference of n lambda gives a bright point, an odd number of half wavelengths a dark one. Only coherent sources, with a constant phase difference, give steady fringes, so we make them from one source. In Young's experiment the path difference is y d over D, and the fringe width is lambda D over d. And interference never destroys energy; it only moves it around.
